exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Data from Cloud Storage
exploitedBy.relevance: Misclassified incident data stored in cloud repositories can be accessed or exposed due to improper data classification controls.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Indicator Blocking
exploitedBy.relevance: Misclassification of incident data can lead to blocking or ignoring critical security indicators, undermining detection efforts.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Data from Information Repositories
exploitedBy.relevance: Excessive access to raw incident data repositories directly mirrors adversarial techniques of extracting sensitive data from information stores.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Exploitation for Credential Access
exploitedBy.relevance: Overly permissive access to raw incident data increases risk of credential and sensitive information exposure through exploitation.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Employee Names
exploitedBy.relevance: Unmasked PII such as employee names in incident records can be harvested by adversaries for identity-related attacks.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Email Addresses
exploitedBy.relevance: Exposed email addresses in unmasked incident records provide adversaries with actionable identity information for targeting.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Log Enumeration
exploitedBy.relevance: Adversaries enumerating logs containing unmasked PII can harvest sensitive personal information from incident records.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Lifecycle-Triggered Deletion
exploitedBy.relevance: Without defined retention policies, lifecycle-triggered deletion controls are absent, leaving incident records vulnerable to improper retention or deletion.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Stored Data Manipulation
exploitedBy.relevance: Undefined retention policies leave stored incident data susceptible to unauthorized manipulation over extended periods.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: File Deletion
exploitedBy.relevance: Without clear retention policies, adversaries or insiders may improperly delete incident records, hindering forensic investigations.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Transfer Data to Cloud Account
exploitedBy.relevance: Transferring incident data across borders to cloud accounts without compliance review mirrors adversarial data exfiltration to external cloud storage.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Data Destruction
exploitedBy.relevance: Insecure disposal of incident records without proper destruction methods leaves sensitive data recoverable by adversaries.
